package net.runelite.client.plugins.microbot.kspaccountbuilder.tasks.skilling.combat.melee.meleescript;

/** Dependency-free regression cases for the Melee bank state machine. */
public final class MeleeBankPolicyRegressionTest
{
    private static int assertions;

    private static void check(boolean success, String message)
    {
        assertions++;
        if (!success) throw new AssertionError(message);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args)
    {
        check(!MeleeBankPolicy.needsOptionalGearBank(true, true),
                "Already armed players must not bank just to inspect other gear");
        check(!MeleeBankPolicy.needsOptionalGearBank(true, false),
                "Existing weapon and no bank weapon must not bank");
        check(!MeleeBankPolicy.needsOptionalGearBank(false, false),
                "Missing gear without a known replacement must not cause a speculative bank walk");
        check(MeleeBankPolicy.needsOptionalGearBank(false, true),
                "Truly missing weapon with a known available replacement can be banked");
        check(!MeleeBankPolicy.needsFoodBank(31, 32, 10000L, false),
                "Missing food at nearly full health must not cause a bank trip");
        check(!MeleeBankPolicy.needsFoodBank(17, 32, 10000L, false),
                "Above the 50 percent reserve is not an immediate resupply request");
        check(MeleeBankPolicy.needsFoodBank(16, 32, 2500L, false),
                "Bank at or below 50 percent with no food for 2.5 seconds");
        check(MeleeBankPolicy.needsFoodBank(13, 32, 3000L, false),
                "Confirmed depleted food and low HP require restocking");
        check(!MeleeBankPolicy.needsFoodBank(13, 32, 2499L, false),
                "Transient missing-food readings must not trigger a trip");
        check(!MeleeBankPolicy.needsFoodBank(13, 32, 10000L, true),
                "Do not interrupt live combat/animation to bank");
        check(!MeleeBankPolicy.needsFoodBank(0, 32, 10000L, false),
                "Dead player uses death handling, not a food bank trip");
        check(!MeleeBankPolicy.needsFoodBank(13, 0, 10000L, false),
                "Unknown max HP is not a confirmed condition");
        check(!MeleeBankPolicy.needsFoodBank(50, 99, 10000L, false),
                "Above half HP on higher-level accounts must not bank");
        check(MeleeBankPolicy.needsFoodBank(49, 99, 10000L, false),
                "Below half HP on higher-level accounts should request food");

        System.out.println("PASS: " + assertions + " Melee bank policy regression checks");
    }
}
